items.title: 68097_Freddie Green oral history interview
items.q: They were -- the two sisters -- they were dancers. They were terrific tap dancers. And they had -- they would -- little Pops -- he was the son. Yeah. Louis.

ctx.x: They have got to be recorded somehow. But the Whitman sisters -- they came through, and they had two kids. Two kids used to dance with -- oh, what's the name of those kids? You see, remember we had a Pops and Louie. Have you ever heard of them, Pops --
